claims.disproof_condition: A new InP substrate entrant reaches meaningful volume share, or updated third-party data shows materially different shares/concentration.
claims.statement: The InP substrate market is a three-player oligopoly (>90% combined): Sumitomo Electric ~42% (~800k wafers/yr capacity), AXT/Beijing Tongmei ~36% (~300k), JX Nippon Mining & Metals ~13% (~200k).

claims.disproof_condition: TRIGGERED 2026-06-16 (recorded 2026-09-18, pq2 [603]) — JX announced a material capacity expansion (JPY 120bn / 7-10x FY2025 capacity), which is exactly the first limb of this condition. Action within 48h of this marking: treat this claim as a historical dated observation only; any current-state statement about InP supply tightness must be re-derived from the three suppliers' own latest disclosures, not from this row. Re-check frequency:每季，或任一供應商再發布產能公告時。 Remaining open limb (announce → **execute**): the announced capacity lands 2026-2028, so the question is no longer whether supply expands but when it arrives — re-check at each of the three suppliers' quarterly reports.
claims.statement: Dated observation (as of 2026-05-16): all three InP substrate suppliers are effectively capacity-constrained — AXT near full utilization (~25-26k wafers/month), Sumitomo largely saturated, JX with no announced expansion plans — so incremental InP demand has no slack supply to absorb it. ⚠ DISPROOF TRIGGERED — marked 2026-09-18 (pq2 [603]). This observation's own disproof condition ('any of the three announces and executes a material capacity expansion') fired **one month after the as-of date**: JX Advanced Metals decided on 2026-06-16 to invest up to JPY 120 billion over four years and to raise InP substrate capacity to 7-10x its FY2025 level (issuer press release, already in this graph as `jx_metals_inp_capacity_pr_2026_06_16`, tier 2). The clause 'JX with no announced expansion plans' is therefore **false as of 2026-06-16 onward**. The as-of sentence is left verbatim because it was true on 2026-05-16 and its source quote says exactly that — but it **must not be cited as the current state of supply**, which is what happened in a 2026-09-17 structural reading. AXT and Sumitomo expansion commitments are recorded elsewhere and are not restated here; re-check them before citing this claim at all.

source_doc.title: Global Semi Research: China's Indium Phosphide Surge — InP substrate market structure

sources.quote: Three players control over 90% of the market
Japan's Sumitomo Electric (~42% share, ~800,000 wafer annual capacity)
U.S.-based AXT including its Chinese subsidiary Beijing Tongmei (~36% share, ~300,000 wafer capacity)
Japan's JX Nippon Mining & Metals (~13% share, ~200,000 wafer output)
AXT's capacity is running near full utilization, shipping approximately 25,000-26,000 wafers monthly.
JX Metals has no announced expansion plans.
